entries.name: On Attack / On Crit (+ Wielding: Magic)

system.description:
Radiant offensive magic that leaves traces of shining light on its target. On hit, 50% chance to inflict the target with 'Shine' status effect. This grants Advantage on the next single attack roll against that unit. If the target already has Shine, change to 100% chance on hit.

Gain 10 additional uses of this spell at B rank proficiency in Divine magic.

Target gains Shield points equal to your Cha. If the target already has Shield points equal to or greater than your Cha, this spell has no effect, nor will this spell put the target at a Shield value greater than your Cha. (Shield points are temporary HP that absorb damage dealt to the unit. If all damage from an attack or effect is absorbed, any Stance damage that would normally accompany the attack or effect is negated.)


Uses: 2 per Divine Proficiency rank
Protected from Holy damage. Vulnerable to Slashing damage.

Heal yourself or an adjacent allied unit by 2d6 + Cha HP and 1d4 Stn. 

 Uses: 5 per Divine Proficiency rank
